candidate_latency_scope: complete agent.act call; teacher includes local adapter/IPC/inference; excludes initialization and platform network
concurrent_workloads: Baseline and teacher qualification overlapped; CPU/MPS acceptance and later workspace activity also overlapped. These are observed loaded-machine measurements, not idle throughput.
game_loop_scope: sum of per-game loop time after agent reset; excludes initialization and final report merge
memory_scope: Raw macOS time -l reported byte counts; not a measured simultaneous sum across parent and Mortal worker processes
original_scope_correction: Original report latency_scope says excludes transport; this is imprecise for the external adapter IPC. Original report bytes are preserved.
process_scope: time real/user/sys for each whole qualification invocation, including setup and verification
